# 2 Baruch Chapter 64 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 64:2 — 'bent down' the law

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "he-bent-down-the-law" |
| LOGOS | "he bent down the law" |
| PNEUMA | "he twisted the law" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Bent down' (Syriac: kafe) is an unusual idiom for distorting/suppressing the law; LOGOS preserves the strangeness of the image which PNEUMA normalizes to 'twisted'.

---

## 64:4 — child sacrifice

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "he-caused-his-children-to-pass-through-the-fire to-the-idol" |
| LOGOS | "he caused his children to pass through the fire to the idol" |
| PNEUMA | "he made his own children pass through fire to the idol" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac formula echoes 2 Kings 21:6 directly; LOGOS mirrors this traditional phrasing more closely than PNEUMA.

---
